meta.title: County and regional indicators: Siaya County and Lake Victoria region
meta.scope: Siaya County (041) values that have no other dataset (poverty), and regional lake totals that Siaya can use beside its own figures. Kisumu rows live in data/counties/kisumu/indicators.json and stay held.
meta.rule: Values as printed, each with source, publication date, period, unit, confidence, table, row, column and PDF page, read from the text layer and checked against the rendered page image by Takwimu. Survey estimates, official statistics, publisher claims and proposed targets are kept apart (field kind). Bounded values such as "<1" keep the bound. Conflicts sit side by side and are never averaged; gaps are listed, never filled. Every value is provisional until a reviewer approves it.
